crossRefs.note: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields; for you are worthy of death. But I will not…
Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s…
Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also…
They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service…
They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…
I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is…
that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

translations.web: Stay with me. Don’t be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. For you will be safe with me.”
translations.bsb: Stay with me; do not be afraid, for he who seeks your life is seeking mine as well. You will be safe with me.”
translations.kjv: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.
translations.asv: Abide thou with me, fear not; for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: for with me thou shalt be in safeguard.
